remarks: Builders & Investors Alert! Exceptional redevelopment opportunity on a CORNER LOT,  33’ x 120’ RF3-zoned lot in a highly desirable location. Don’t miss your chance to secure a valuable piece of land in a rapidly developing area! (id:67522)
